content: This product's safety, effectiveness, or appropriateness for your use cannot be guaranteed based on this information. The details provided here are not intended to replace personalized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for consultation with your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, in Canada, reach out to your doctor for guidance on side effects. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is less critical, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it has expired or is no longer needed. Follow local guidelines or consult your pharmacist for appropriate disposal methods. The information provided here was last updated in May 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. This information does not ensure that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional for complete and personalized guidance. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
